title: Elastic Load Balancing
explanation: Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) automatically distributes incoming application traffic across multiple targets such as EC2 instances, containers, and IP addresses. AWS offers three types: Application Load Balancer (ALB), Network Load Balancer (NLB), and Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB).
analogy: A load balancer is like a restaurant host who seats guests (requests) at different tables (servers) to ensure no single table is overwhelmed while others sit empty.
keyPoints: ALB operates at Layer 7 (HTTP/HTTPS) with content-based routing
NLB operates at Layer 4 (TCP/UDP) with ultra-low latency
GWLB operates at Layer 3 for third-party virtual appliances
All ELB types support cross-zone load balancing and health checks

examKeywords.definition: A Layer 7 load balancer supporting content-based routing, host-based routing, path-based routing, and WebSocket connections.

commonMistakes: Using ALB when ultra-low latency is required — NLB is better for TCP/UDP performance
Not enabling cross-zone load balancing, leading to uneven traffic distribution
